text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... this cuisine has quite a
distinctive
appearance, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! This restaurant's decor is
bizarre in its
own right, but the food is
even more... How do I
put it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A bowl of what can only be described as
black tar
bubbles away before me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This all started with an invitation Mejiro
Ardan
extended as we were on our way
back from an
excursion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, Fine and I have plans to
meet at a
restaurant shortly. You're
quite welcome to join
us for the meal if
you like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, I was led to a strikingly eerie

restaurant with a sign outside reading
"Taste of
Darkness - Sombre Totale."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you once again for treating me to
that
delicious ramen the other day, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I had hoped to treat you to a memorable experience as a show of gratitude—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And you've picked the right place! I can
definitely
see us making some grand
memories here! This is
my first visit, after
all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm pleased to hear that... I must
admit I'm
somewhat inexperienced when
it comes to dining
out with friends.
choice_data_list: （たしかに初めてだろうけど……！）

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's make the absolute
most of
today!
Pardon me, but would
you mind ladling some of
that into those
bowls?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do take care. Within the soup, there
appears to
be—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Bloop! Sploosh!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Something tentacular. ...My apologies.
I ought
to have warned you sooner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But soup ingredients aren't supposed to
move?!
Even while scared out of my wits,
I somehow
manage to serve up the soup
for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Now, let's see how it tastes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall try some as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweating bullets, I bring a solid chunk
toward my
lips. Chaos incarnate sits
between my chopsticks.
Is this fish?
Meat? Some sort of pudding?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's like the chef combined every flavor
in
existence into a single mouthful. My
tongue goes
numb. Darkness consumes
me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: W-wow?! ...This flavor's something else! Amazing! I have never tasted anything like this before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against all odds, Fine Motion seems to
be
enjoying it. But this flavor... I struggle
against it
for as long as I can, then just
as I'm about to put
down my
chopsticks...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clink.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see... So this is the "taste of darkness"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of the corner of my eye, I see that
Mejiro
Ardan has finished every last
drop of her soup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It was... unique. Its flavor was something
akin to
that of herbal medicine, health
foods, things of
that nature...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That said, I'm rather used to such tastes.
Yes, I
hardly realized how quickly I was
getting through
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That said, I'm rather used to such tastes.
Yes, I
hardly realized how quickly I was
getting through
it.
choice_data_list: アルダンはたくましい……な……！
アルダンはたくましい……ね……！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Tough... you say?
choice_data_list: アルダンはたくましい……な……！
アルダンはたくましい……ね……！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hehe, I apologize. It's just quite a
surprise to
hear that word and my name
in the same breath.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But to hear myself described as such... It
makes
me rewarded for having tasted all
those different
medicines over the years.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It just goes to show that even the
strangest of
flavors have their upsides!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Hehe. It might be nice to have
more
adventures like this, from time to
time. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I think of the soup as an herbal
concoction, I
think I can do it! Taking my
chopsticks in hand, I
continue eating...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And feel like... I grow a tiny bit tougher
in the
process.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan went out of her way to
invite me.
What kind of guest doesn't
finish what they're
served? Gritting my
teeth, I pick up my
chopsticks once
again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but... the color appears to
be draining
from your face. Are you all
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please don't feel pressured to eat. The
two of us
are quite capable of finishing
the rest...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sure we are! I think I'm getting used to
the taste
too! Still, I don't see myself
forgetting about this
flavor anytime
soon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that was fast. Did you find it to
your
liking?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would you like seconds? It looks like
you can
choose between saffron rice and
jade noodles as
a side, too. Which do
you fancy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You will?
In that case, shall we order
those for us later,
Fine?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only now do I notice how perfectly
comfortable
Mejiro Ardan looks as she
tucks into her second
bowl of soup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... The day turns out to be a
special one
indeed, with my getting to
witness an unexpected
toughness to
Mejiro Ardan...
